speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked the Minister for Transport whether there is any requirement for all EV charging stations to be insured against fire and damage to the building housing them and surrounding cars.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: The other question, if I may ask the Minister of State, is whether the insurance just covers the owners of the car park, primarily the Housing and Development Board (HDB), or would it also cover managers of the car park, like Town Councils?

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is looking at this quite closely.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: From the perspective of fire incidents in Singapore, thankfully, it has remained quite low.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: So, we will continue to look at it and then, based on the experience, we will take whatever further steps that are necessary.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: So, that is the ambit of the policy.
